INSERT INTO comment_limits(bucket,window,count) VALUES(?,?,1) ON CONFLICT(bucket) DO UPDATE SET count=CASE WHEN window=excluded.window THEN count+1 ELSE 1 END,window=excluded.window WHERE window<>excluded.window OR count

INSERT INTO rate_limits(visitor_id,window,count) VALUES(?,?,1) ON CONFLICT(visitor_id) DO UPDATE SET count=CASE WHEN window=excluded.window THEN count+1 ELSE 1 END,window=excluded.window WHERE window<>excluded.window OR count<60 RETURNING count

INSERT INTO search_usage(bucket,window,count) VALUES(?,?,1) ON CONFLICT(bucket) DO UPDATE SET count=CASE WHEN window=excluded.window THEN count+1 ELSE 1 END,window=excluded.window WHERE window<>excluded.window OR count
